messages:
Andrew: Heads-up — planning a staging->prod cutover tonight 22:00 PDT. Primary goals: deploy v2.14, run quick smoke, and be ready to rollback within 15m if perf/regressions. Who can own smoke checks and rollback?
Mari: I can own smoke for infra and basic latency checks. Will be oncall. :thumbsup:
Tyler: I can watch model quality/latency histograms and run a couple of prompt sanity tests. Do we have a canary percent?
Andrew: Thanks. Initial plan: 5% canary for 10m, then 25% for 15m if green, then full. Can adjust if metrics look off.
Priya: FYI we have the DB feature-flag toggle for new embeddings migration — keeping it off for prod cutover unless we flip afterwards. Confirmed?
Andrew: Correct — feature flag stays OFF. Embedding migration is a separate window.
Sean: Quick checklist: 1) infra smoke (Mari), 2) model perf QA (Tyler), 3) rollout monitor (me) — looking at error budget and 95p latency, 4) rollback owner (Barbara).
Barbara: I can own rollback. Prepared playbook and will be ready to run rollback steps. Paste quick rollback commands in thread pls.
Andrew: Rollback commands (kube):
```
# revert to previous replicaset
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime -n prod
# scale down canary deployment
kubectl scale deploy/inference-canary --replicas=0 -n prod
# quick sanity: curl health
curl -s https://api.redwood.example/healthz | jq .
```
Also have a console toggle to force traffic back to stable.
Tyler: For smoke prompts, I'll run: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"summarize: The quick brown fox"}'` and check token/time and output coherence.
Mari: Infra smoke steps: 1) check GPU pool utilization in console, 2) run health endpoints, 3) validate KV cache hit metrics. Commands: `gcloud compute ssh infra-proxy -- gtop` and console links.
Opsbot: Deploy scheduled by Andrew for 2026-03-17T22:00:00-07:00. Reminder 30m before window.
Priya: Any DB schema or migration impacts? I double-checked with data team — none for this cutover.
Andrew: Ok owners: infra smoke = Mari, model QA = Tyler, rollout monitor = Sean, rollback = Barbara. I'll coordinate the canary percent changes and call green/rollback.
Sean: I'll set up the dashboard and alert channel. If 95p latency > 800ms or errors > 0.5% during canary -> immediate rollback.
Barbara: Confirmed — I'll be on the standby call number. If rollback executed, I'll post timestamps and commands run.
Tyler: Quick ask — can we pin the eval prompt set in the console so I can rerun the same regression tests during canary?
Andrew: Yes — created eval set "canary-smoke-2026-03-17" and granted Tyler access.
Mari: Preflight checklist done: infra nodes ready, rollout capacity reserved, snapshot of current ASG config taken.
Priya: I'll update the runbook with the feature-flag note.
Andrew: Last ask: react with :eyes: when you are at your workstation by 21:30 PDT so we know owners are available.
Tyler: :eyes:
Mari: :eyes:
Barbara: :eyes:
Sean: :eyes:
Priya: :eyes:
Andrew: Thanks all — will post canary start message at 22:00 and update during windows.
